record.name: LiveAgent
record.one_liner: Help desk and customer support software featuring ticketing, live chat, call center, and AI tools.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free trial and generate API keys directly in the admin panel.
record.api_note: The API covers tickets, messages, knowledge base entries, reports, and management workflows.
